report.insight: Rating Screen Bugs jumped from 0 to 11 complaints after the 5.2 update, while Promo Codes fell from 10 to 3 and Order Tracking improved from 13 to 5.

priorities.fix: Roll back the rating screen changes from update 5.2 or add a hotfix to dismiss the popup after first submission and prevent duplicate tip processing.
priorities.name: Rating Screen Bugs
priorities.why: 11 customers are blocked by a persistent rating popup that won't dismiss and prevents access to cart, with 2 customers reporting unauthorized tip charges through the same screen.

priorities.fix: Analyze delivery time data for orders with cold food complaints to identify routing inefficiencies or driver assignment delays, then test priority dispatch for temperature-sensitive orders.
priorities.name: Cold or Poor Quality Food
priorities.why: 6 customers received cold food this month (up from 2 last month), with delivery times exceeding 60-70 minutes causing quality and potential safety issues.

priorities.fix: Implement payment reconciliation monitoring to catch failed-but-charged transactions within 5 minutes and auto-refund, while investigating the root cause of checkout timeouts.
priorities.name: Checkout and Payment Failures
priorities.why: 8 customers experienced checkout problems including crashes, timeouts, and payment failures where money was debited but orders weren't confirmed.

report.summary: This month's top issue is a new Rating Screen Bugs problem (11 complaints) introduced in update 5.2 that blocks ordering and may be charging unauthorized tips. We're also seeing worsening Cold Food complaints (6 vs 2 last month) and stable Checkout/Payment Failures (8 complaints). Good news: Order Tracking, Late Deliveries, and Promo Codes are all improving. Note: A critical allergy instruction failure (B2-042) is being handled separately as an urgent safety issue.
